---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature, capability, or architectural enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Summary
Provide a clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Describe the context, user pain point, or architectural limitation that this feature resolves.

## Proposed Solution
Detail the technical specification, service layer changes, database schema modifications, or UI/UX workflows.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or architectural patterns that were evaluated.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Requirement 1
- [ ] Requirement 2
- [ ] Unit and integration test coverage included
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Additional Context
Add any relevant API contracts, diagrams, or benchmarks.
